ram_guard_revision_basis.failure: RAM guard below 2.5 GiB for 180 s while available RAM was 2.479 GiB
ram_guard_revision_basis.reason: The 2.5 GiB emergency threshold was too close to normal hosted-runner steady-state availability and aborted an otherwise healthy simulator. 1.5 GiB retains a substantial emergency margin while avoiding this false-positive guard condition.

reason_for_p24_disk_guard: Protocol-023's 20 GiB guard was registered for a local workstation. The GitHub-hosted runner exposed 10.897 GiB free before interval 0, so the inherited 20 GiB threshold can never run here. Protocol-024 artifacts are bounded arrays for 4981x16 hosts plus model outputs and are far below 5 GiB; 5 GiB preserves a substantial safety margin without changing experiment physics.
